#### `can_place_sculk_patch_on` {#can_place_sculk_patch_on}

<p class="fl-facts">required · blockList</p>

**The blocks a neighbour has to be for the patch to take hold.**

Checked against the six neighbours of the origin, and at least one must match. An EMPTY array is not the same as an absent key: empty means "any solid neighbour will do", and the key itself is required either way.

#### `central_block` {#central_block}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · block · absent: no central block is placed</p>

**An optional single block placed at the centre of the patch.**

Absent means no central block, and the roll that would have placed it still happens.

#### `central_block_placement_chance` {#central_block_placement_chance}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · number · absent: 0.0 -- NOT 1.0, which is the guess this field usually gets</p>

**Chance the central block is placed.**

It also needs a solid block below the origin. Note the default -- it is 0, so the central block is off unless you ask for it.

#### `charge_amount` {#charge_amount}

<p class="fl-facts">required · integer · range [1, 1000]</p>

**How much spread charge each cursor starts with.**

More charge means the patch can travel further from where each cursor was seeded.

#### `cursor_count` {#cursor_count}

<p class="fl-facts">required · integer · range [0, 32]</p>

**How many spread cursors are seeded per round.**

Seeded fresh each round and cleared at the end of it, so this is a per-round number, not a total.

#### `spread_attempts` {#spread_attempts}

<p class="fl-facts">required · integer · range [1, 4]</p>

**How many times the spread pass runs within each round.**

Each attempt moves the round's cursors on once more, so more attempts means a patch that reaches further per round.

The schema bounds this to [1, 4], so it is not a way to switch the spread off.

#### `growth_rounds` {#growth_rounds}

<p class="fl-facts">required · integer · range [0, 8]</p>

**How many of the rounds are growth rounds.**

Growth and spread rounds run back to back; the total number of rounds is the two added together.

#### `spread_rounds` {#spread_rounds}

<p class="fl-facts">required · integer · range [0, 8]</p>

**How many of the rounds are spread rounds.**

Growth and spread rounds run back to back; the total number of rounds is the two added together.

#### `extra_growth_chance` {#extra_growth_chance}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · range · absent: {0, 0}</p>

**An extra amount of growth, drawn once from this range.**

A zero-width range adds nothing and costs no draw, which is what an absent key gives you.
